water_system: Cleveland Division of Water / Cleveland Water
notes: Average daily water use is derived by summing current published plant averages (Baldwin 71.1, Crown 40, Garrett Morgan 60, Nottingham ~65 MGD). Treatment capacity of 540 MGD was supplied by the user on 2026-08-26; retain the user's '*' qualification and add the exact source citation when available. Cleveland Water also reports service to 80 communities.

source_name: Upper Cuyahoga River watershed / four-reservoir system; Lake Rockwell immediately supplies treatment plant
notes: System covers 207 square miles and serves 13 communities. Supporting context retained in raw research: 120 MGD potential watershed supply, potential supplemental groundwater capacity of 22 MGD, and annual production of 11.1 BG.

MVSD is an analytical regional water-system case and should not be interpreted as a confirmed direct provider for every associated data-center project. Supporting context retained in raw research includes 11 BG reservoir storage, 30 MGD drought safe yield, 9.2 BG 2024 annual production, 9.6 BG website-reported 2025 production, and 35.9 MG distribution storage.

water_system: Erie County Water Division — Perkins District (OH2200603)
source_name: Purchased treated water from City of Sandusky and City of Huron; ultimately Lake Erie
notes: Perkins purchases finished water and does not operate a treatment plant. Do not substitute Erie County Water Division's ~6.05 MGD five-year average purchases for Perkins-specific use. Raw research also retains >2 BG distributed countywide in 2024 and historical Perkins context.

water_system: Lake County Department of Utilities — East Sub-District / Bacon Road WTP
notes: Average daily use is reported as roughly 3 MGD. Supporting context retained in raw research includes up to 9 MGD raw-water conveyance capacity, at least 1.0 MG clearwell storage, and ~1.095 BG/year implied by 3 MGD (derived, not reported annual production).

water_system: Portage County Water Resources — Shalersville system
notes: Do not use PCWR systemwide production of 3.12 MGD plus 0.20 MGD purchased as a Shalersville denominator. PCWR overall equivalent population is ~30,000, but the Shalersville WTP-specific served population has not been established. The plant serves Streetsboro and portions of Shalersville, Franklin and Ravenna townships.
